description: This file provides functions for HTTP ETag manipulation, including matching ETags, remixing (updating) ETag values, and creating ETags based on file system metadata such as inode number, size, and modification time.

methods.name: int http_etag_matches(const buffer * const etag,const char * s,const int weak_ok)
methods.description: Checks if a given ETag matches any of the tags in a given string, considering weak ETags if allowed.

methods.name: void http_etag_remix(buffer * const etag,const char * const str,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Updates the ETag buffer with a hash derived from a string and its length.

methods.name: void http_etag_create(buffer * const etag,const struct stat * const st,const int flags)
methods.description: Creates a new ETag for a file based on its inode, size, and modification time, depending on specified flags.

ctags.name: http_etag_create
ctags.pattern: /^http_etag_create (buffer * const etag, const struct stat * const st, const int flags)$/
ctags.signature: (buffer * const etag,const struct stat * const st,const int flags)

ctags.name: http_etag_matches
ctags.pattern: /^http_etag_matches (const buffer * const etag, const char *s, const int weak_ok)$/
ctags.signature: (const buffer * const etag,const char * s,const int weak_ok)

ctags.name: http_etag_remix
ctags.pattern: /^http_etag_remix (buffer * const etag, const char * const str, const uint32_t len)$/
ctags.signature: (buffer * const etag,const char * const str,const uint32_t len)
